name: AIChip
description: AIChip consolidates four formerly separate chip atoms (memory, brief, status, handoff) into one component discriminated on a `kind` prop. Each kind preserves its own sub-taxonomy: memory `variant`, brief `status`, status `tone`, handoff `direction`. Output is pixel-identical to the former atoms — this is purely an API consolidation so the shared pill conventions live in one place.
intent: The single pill atom for the AI system. `kind` selects memory context, task-brief status, outcome status, or an agent handoff — all sharing radius, sizing, and caption typography.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: label
props.hint: memory / brief / status — the pill text. (handoff uses fromLabel + toLabel instead.)

props.name: noDot
props.hint: kind="brief" — hides the status dot (role/label chips).

props.name: accentColor
props.hint: kind="brief" — overrides the derived dot / text accent color.

props.name: accentBg
props.hint: kind="brief" — overrides the derived chip background fill.

props.name: onDark
props.hint: kind="status" — switches to the dark-surface tone palette.

props.name: fromLabel
props.hint: kind="handoff" — name of the source party.

props.name: toLabel
props.hint: kind="handoff" — name of the target party.

props.name: dismissible
props.hint: kind="tag" — shows the trailing zs-icon-close dismiss button (suppressed when active/disabled).

props.name: leftIcon
props.hint: kind="tag" — leading zs-icon-globe-fill; icon colour tracks the state (white when active, muted when disabled).

props.name: dataColor
props.hint: kind="tag" — custom data-viz colour (border + label + filled-circle dismiss). Overrides the semantic state palette; renders as a rounded pill.

props.name: dataTint
props.hint: kind="tag" — background tint paired with dataColor. Defaults to the data colour at ~10% alpha.
